title: Good Rankings, Poor Choices? Rethinking Language-Only Vision-Language Model Selection
abstract: arXiv:2610.34685v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Language-Only Vision-Language Model Selection (LOVM) aims to identify the Vision-Language Model (VLM) with the highest zero-shot accuracy on a target task using only textual information. We revisit the existing LOVM evaluation protocol and argue that ranking metrics, such as top-5 recall and Kendall's rank correlation, do not directly assess the performance of the selected model. We therefore adopt simple regret (SR), defined as the performance gap between the best and selected models, and introduce Outlier-Robust Normalized Regret (ORNR) to account for the varying performance ranges across tasks while reducing sensitivity to outliers. Building on this revised evaluation protocol, we propose Target-Conditioned Expected Source Regret (TC-ESR), a training-free method that selects the model with the lowest similarity-weighted mean regret across source tasks. translated_title: 排名虽好，选择不佳？重新思考仅基于语言的视觉-语言模型选择
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.34685v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：仅基于语言的视觉-语言模型选择旨在仅利用文本信息，识别出在目标任务上零样本准确率最高的视觉-语言模型（VLM）。我们重新审视了现有的LOVM评估协议，并指出诸如top-5召回率和Kendall秩相关系数等排名指标并不能直接评估所选模型的实际性能。因此，我们采用简单遗憾，其定义为最佳模型与所选模型之间的性能差距，并进一步引入离群值鲁棒归一化遗憾，以兼顾不同任务间性能范围的差异，同时降低对离群值的敏感度。基于这一修订后的评估协议，我们提出了目标条件化期望源任务遗憾，这是一种无需训练的方法，通过相似度加权的源任务平均遗憾来选择遗憾最低的模型。在22个目标任务和43个VLM的实验中，TC-ESR取得了最低的平均SR和ORNR。
tldr: 该论文重新审视了仅基于语言的视觉-语言模型选择（LOVM）的评估协议，指出排名指标无法直接衡量所选模型性能，转而采用简单遗憾（SR）和离群值鲁棒归一化遗憾（ORNR）作为新评估标准，并提出无需训练的TC-ESR方法，在22个目标任务和43个VLM上取得了最低的平均遗憾。
